measurements.name: t_start_lo
measurements.spice: .meas tran t_start_lo WHEN v(out_lo)=0.8 RISE=1 TD=0.2u

measurements.name: t1_lo
measurements.spice: .meas tran t1_lo WHEN v(out_lo)=0.8 RISE=1 TD=14u

measurements.name: t3_lo
measurements.spice: .meas tran t3_lo WHEN v(out_lo)=0.8 RISE=3 TD=14u

measurements.name: tl1_lo
measurements.spice: .meas tran tl1_lo WHEN v(out_lo)=0.8 RISE=1 TD=36u

measurements.name: tl3_lo
measurements.spice: .meas tran tl3_lo WHEN v(out_lo)=0.8 RISE=3 TD=36u

measurements.name: freq_lo
measurements.spice: .meas tran freq_lo param='2/(t3_lo-t1_lo)'

measurements.name: drift_lo_pct
measurements.spice: .meas tran drift_lo_pct param='100*((tl3_lo-tl1_lo)-(t3_lo-t1_lo))/(t3_lo-t1_lo)'

measurements.name: t_start_mid
measurements.spice: .meas tran t_start_mid WHEN v(out_mid)=0.8 RISE=1 TD=0.2u

measurements.name: t1_mid
measurements.spice: .meas tran t1_mid WHEN v(out_mid)=0.8 RISE=1 TD=14u

measurements.name: t3_mid
measurements.spice: .meas tran t3_mid WHEN v(out_mid)=0.8 RISE=3 TD=14u

measurements.name: tl1_mid
measurements.spice: .meas tran tl1_mid WHEN v(out_mid)=0.8 RISE=1 TD=36u

measurements.name: tl3_mid
measurements.spice: .meas tran tl3_mid WHEN v(out_mid)=0.8 RISE=3 TD=36u

measurements.name: freq_mid
measurements.spice: .meas tran freq_mid param='2/(t3_mid-t1_mid)'

measurements.name: drift_mid_pct
measurements.spice: .meas tran drift_mid_pct param='100*((tl3_mid-tl1_mid)-(t3_mid-t1_mid))/(t3_mid-t1_mid)'

measurements.name: t_start_hi
measurements.spice: .meas tran t_start_hi WHEN v(out_hi)=0.8 RISE=1 TD=0.2u

measurements.name: t1_hi
measurements.spice: .meas tran t1_hi WHEN v(out_hi)=0.8 RISE=1 TD=14u

measurements.name: t3_hi
measurements.spice: .meas tran t3_hi WHEN v(out_hi)=0.8 RISE=3 TD=14u

measurements.name: tl1_hi
measurements.spice: .meas tran tl1_hi WHEN v(out_hi)=0.8 RISE=1 TD=36u

measurements.name: tl3_hi
measurements.spice: .meas tran tl3_hi WHEN v(out_hi)=0.8 RISE=3 TD=36u

measurements.name: freq_hi
measurements.spice: .meas tran freq_hi param='2/(t3_hi-t1_hi)'

measurements.name: drift_hi_pct
measurements.spice: .meas tran drift_hi_pct param='100*((tl3_hi-tl1_hi)-(t3_hi-t1_hi))/(t3_hi-t1_hi)'

measurements.name: ratio_mid_lo
measurements.spice: .meas tran ratio_mid_lo param='freq_mid/freq_lo'

measurements.name: ratio_hi_mid
measurements.spice: .meas tran ratio_hi_mid param='freq_hi/freq_mid'

measurements.name: vco_sensitivity
measurements.spice: .meas tran vco_sensitivity param='(freq_hi-freq_lo)/(vctrl_hi-vctrl_lo)'

measurements.name: vco_sens_lo_mid
measurements.spice: .meas tran vco_sens_lo_mid param='(freq_mid-freq_lo)/(vctrl_mid-vctrl_lo)'

measurements.name: vco_sens_mid_hi
measurements.spice: .meas tran vco_sens_mid_hi param='(freq_hi-freq_mid)/(vctrl_hi-vctrl_mid)'

measurements.name: vs_lo_v
measurements.spice: .meas tran vs_lo_v AVG v(xvco_lo.vs) FROM=14u TO=50u

measurements.name: vs_err_lo_mv
measurements.spice: .meas tran vs_err_lo_mv param='1000*(vs_lo_v-vctrl_lo)'

measurements.name: vs_hi_v
measurements.spice: .meas tran vs_hi_v AVG v(xvco_hi.vs) FROM=14u TO=50u

measurements.name: vs_err_hi_mv
measurements.spice: .meas tran vs_err_hi_mv param='1000*(vs_hi_v-vctrl_hi)'
